This document outlines the 
 equipment inspection 
I1, which must be carried out every six months which indicated by M6 in the 
little block.

This pump function to transfer water from high pressure 
drum to high pressure evaporator then to high pressure
drum again.

The first draft initiated by eng .Abdallah
Saada, revised by accepted by eng. Hassan Elgendy, accepted by eng. Magdey Hegazy, and approved by eng. Khamis
Elsherif Maintenance General Manager and approved by 
eng. Mohamed Abd Elathim 
Head Sector of Mahmoudia Power Station.

This document accepted by eng. Samir 
Abdel Gilil; MEPC inspection & quality control general 
Manager & 
MPIS coordinator, and certified by Eng Mohamed Nageeb inspection & quality control's head sector.

A work permit
must be issued.

The maintenance staff should carry the suitable ID safety
category.

Maintenance staff
should be well trained, qualified or directly supervised by some one who is.

Safety fence with
caution marks surrounding the work area is required.

Personal protective equipment must be used as safety shoes, and safety helmet 
 .... etc

Disconnect the power supply & rack out the circuit
breaker.
Put red tag on the pump.
Close the shutoff valves in the (suction & discharge& balancing & min flow ).

Let the pumps cool down to about < 80oC measured at
the branches, then seal off the cooling water pipes and close all other supply
lines.

Loosen all auxiliary lines, such as circulation, cooling
liquid, lube oil.

The safety department must check the isolation and surrounding
the zone of work.

Power Stations | Technical Procedure
Introduction
This document outlines the 
 equipment inspection 
I1, which must be carried out every six months which indicated by M6 in the 
little block.
This pump function to transfer water from high pressure 
drum to high pressure evaporator then to high pressure
drum again.
The pump technical data:
Type | Centrifugal Pump |  | No. of pumps | 16
No. of Stages | 1 |  | Suction 
 Pressure | 23.6 bar
Power | 12 KW |  | Discharge 
 Pressure | 24.8 bar
Capacity | 264 m3/h |  | Pumped Liquid | Boiler Water 223C
Speed | 1470 
 rpm |  | Shaft Seal | Mechanical Seal
The first draft initiated by eng .Abdallah
Saada, revised by accepted by eng. Hassan Elgendy, accepted by eng. Magdey Hegazy, and approved by eng. Khamis
Elsherif Maintenance General Manager and approved by 
eng. Mohamed Abd Elathim 
Head Sector of Mahmoudia Power Station.
This document accepted by eng. Samir 
Abdel Gilil; MEPC inspection & quality control general 
Manager & 
MPIS coordinator, and certified by Eng Mohamed Nageeb inspection & quality control's head sector.
Safety 
Precautions
A work permit
must be issued.
The maintenance staff should carry the suitable ID safety
category.
Maintenance staff
should be well trained, qualified or directly supervised by some one who is.
Safety fence with
caution marks surrounding the work area is required.
Personal protective equipment must be used as safety shoes, and safety helmet 
 .... etc
Shutdown the pump.
Disconnect the power supply & rack out the circuit
breaker.
Put red tag on the pump.
Close the shutoff valves in the (suction & discharge& balancing & min flow ).
Let the pumps cool down to about < 80oC measured at
the branches, then seal off the cooling water pipes and close all other supply
lines.
Loosen all auxiliary lines, such as circulation, cooling
liquid, lube oil.
The safety department must check the isolation and surrounding
the zone of work.

Dismantling 
Steps
Disconnect the motor electrically.
Isolate the pump from suction and discharge by closing
the valves.
Drain pump casing, bearing frame and cooling circuit.
Disconnect all auxiliary circuits.
Remove coupling guard.
Remove coupling spacer to allow dismantling of the pump
with disturbing either motor or pump casing.
Loosen fixing screws on back frame foot of the pump.
Unscrew fixing nuts on stuffing box.
Remove the assembly consisting of bearing frame and
stuffing box from pump casing making use of the extracting screws specially
provided for this purpose.
Dismantle the impeller.
Dismantle the stuffing box.
Dismantle the bearing assembly.

Procedures
Change (O-rings) and gaskets
if necessary.
Change the oil if necessary.
Check all wearing parts before assembly and
repaired or replaced if necessary.

cover.
